events.title: Play the first level of My Arms Are Longer Now for free!
events.summary: My Arms Are Longer Now has a live demo available during Steam Next Fest. This demo features the first level of the game and can be downloaded now for FREE. My Arms Are Longer Now will be launching early 2027. Follow us on social media to learn more about development progress. (@wearetootgames)

events.title: My Arms Are Longer Now | Cinematic Trailer | Wishlist Now!
events.summary: The arm of the law is long, but your arm is longer now. Pinch, slap, trip, romance, and steal your way through the absurd comedy world of My Arms Are Longer Now. Coming Soon to Steam.

events.title: Wishlist Milestone Reward
events.summary: The people have spoken and they have demanded feet. We polled our followers on Instagram to see which in-game cosmetic they’d like to see added to My Arms Are Longer Now if we hit our Steam wishlist milestone, and between the story and feed poll… Foot Mode won. You little weirdos. What does this mean? events.title: Jackbox Games is publishing My Arms Are Longer Now!
events.summary: My Arms are Longer Now, a humorous single-player heist game which will have players solving environmental puzzles using one incredibly long, yucky arm, will launch on PC via Steam and Epic in Fall 2026 before making its way to consoles in 2027. Developed by the Melbourne-based indie studio Toot Games, My Arms are Longer Now will be published in partnership with Jackbox Games.
